name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
subsidy_details: General category: 15% (Urban), 25% (Rural). Special category (SC/ST/OBC/Minority/Women/Divyangjan/NER): 25% (Urban), 35% (Rural).
education_requirement: 8th pass for projects above ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing and ₹5 Lakh in services
required_documents: Educational qualification certificate (8th class marksheet/certificate if applicable)
Special Category Certificate (Divyangjan / Ex-servicemen if applicable)
Rural Area Certificate (issued by Gram Panchayat / BDO if applicable)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate self-employment through setting up micro-enterprises in non-farm sector. Loans up to ₹50 Lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 Lakh for service sector with government subsidy up to 35%.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Shishu
ministry: Ministry of Finance
subsidy_details: No collateral required. Micro loans with nominal interest and processing fee waiver. Women borrowers receive interest rebate.
required_documents: Quotations of items/machinery to be purchased
Bank Account Statement for last 6 months
description: Micro-finance scheme covering small entrepreneurs starting a new micro-business or requiring early-stage equipment/working capital up to ₹50,000 without collateral.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Kishore
ministry: Ministry of Finance
subsidy_details: Collateral-free bank loan with competitive interest rates and flexible repayment tenure (3-5 years).
required_documents: Balance Sheet / Profit & Loss statement for past 1-2 years (for existing business)
Quotation of machinery/assets to be purchased
description: Loan facility between ₹50,000 and ₹5,00,000 for mid-tier small enterprises looking to purchase raw materials, machinery, or expand their customer base.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY) - Tarun & Tarun Plus
ministry: Ministry of Finance
subsidy_percentage: Credit guarantee coverage, low margin requirement
subsidy_details: Loans from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh for seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously repaid Kishore/Tarun loans successfully.
required_documents: Last 2 years audited financial statements and ITR
description: Substantial working capital and asset creation loan from ₹5 Lakh up to ₹20 Lakh for growing MSMEs with established track record.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance / SIDBI
subsidy_percentage: Low margin requirement (up to 15%), handholding support
subsidy_details: Bank loan covering up to 85% of project cost (composite loan for term loan and working capital). In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% shareholding must be held by SC/ST or Women.
required_documents: Caste Certificate (SC/ST) or Woman entrepreneur identity proof
Proof of Registered Office / Factory premises
Partnership deed / RoC incorporation with 51% SC/ST/Woman ownership certificate
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to at least one SC or ST borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise.

name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
name_hi: पीएम स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स आत्मनिर्भर निधि (पीएम स्वनिधि)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
subsidy_details: Initial tranche ₹10,000, 2nd tranche ₹20,000, 3rd tranche ₹50,000 upon timely repayment. 7% interest subsidy directly credited to bank account quarterly.
required_documents: Vending Certificate or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB)
Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB / Town Vending Committee (if ID not issued)
description: Special micro-credit facility for urban street vendors, hawkers, and informal sellers to resume livelihoods with low-interest collateral-free working capital.

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT)
subsidy_percentage: Grant up to ₹20L + Convertible Debentures up to ₹50L
subsidy_details: Up to ₹20 Lakhs as grant for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials. Up to ₹50 Lakhs of investment through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments.
required_documents: DPIIT Recognition Certificate (Startups must be incorporated < 2 years)
Business Plan with Proof of Concept timeline
description: Provides financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry and commercialization via certified incubators.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises (PMFME)
name_hi: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना (PMFME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI)
subsidy_details: Credit-linked capital subsidy at 35% of the eligible project cost with a maximum ceiling of ₹10 Lakh per unit. Special seed capital of ₹40,000 per SHG member.
required_documents: FSSAI Food License / Registration (or commitment to obtain)
Detailed Project Report (DPR) on food processing unit
Electricity Bill / Land ownership or Rent agreement
description: Financial, technical, and business support for upgrading micro food processing units (One District One Product - ODOP emphasis), pickle/spice making, bakery, dairy, and agro-processing.

name: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of MSME & SIDBI
subsidy_details: Up to 85% guarantee coverage for loans up to ₹5 Lakh to micro enterprises, women entrepreneurs, and units in NER. Collateral-free facility up to ₹5 Crore.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with cash-flow analysis
Financial statements of last 2 years (if existing unit)
Sanction letter from Member Lending Institution (Bank/NBFC)
description: Enables micro and small enterprises to access collateral-free institutional credit with government guarantee coverage up to ₹500 Lakhs.

name: NSIC Single Point Registration & Raw Material Assistance
name_hi: एनएसआईसी एकल बिंदु पंजीकरण एवं कच्चा माल सहायता
ministry: Ministry of MSME
subsidy_percentage: Exemption from EMD, tender fee waiver, raw material credit
subsidy_details: Free tender sets, exemption from earnest money deposit (EMD), and 25% mandatory procurement preference from MSEs including 4% from SC/ST and 3% from Women.
required_documents: List of plant, machinery and testing equipment installed
Audited Balance sheet & P&L of past 3 years
Quality standards / BIS certification if applicable
description: Government e-procurement enablement and raw material assistance for MSMEs with complete exemption from Earnest Money Deposit and tender purchase costs.

name: Maharashtra Chief Minister Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
ministry: Directorate of Industries, Government of Maharashtra
subsidy_details: Manufacturing: up to ₹50 Lakh. Service/Agri: up to ₹20 Lakh. Special categories (SC/ST/Women/Divyangjan/Ex-servicemen) receive 25% (Urban) or 35% (Rural) subsidy with only 5% own contribution.
education_requirement: 7th pass for projects > ₹10L in manufacturing or > ₹5L in service; 10th pass for projects > ₹25L
description: Maharashtra state-specific flagship scheme to generate 1 Lakh micro enterprises per year with credit linked subsidy up to 35% for rural and urban youth.

name: UP Mukhyamantri Yuva Swarojgar Yojana (MMYSY)
name_hi: उत्तर प्रदेश मुख्यमंत्री युवा स्वरोजगार योजना
ministry: Department of MSME and Export Promotion, Government of UP
subsidy_details: 25% margin money subsidy on project cost up to ₹25 Lakh for industrial sector (max ₹6.25L) and up to ₹10 Lakh for service sector (max ₹2.5L). Subsidy converts to grant after 2 years of successful operation.
required_documents: Notarized Affidavit declaring no previous loan default
description: Financial assistance and margin money grant for educated unemployed youth of Uttar Pradesh to establish industrial or service units.

name: Tamil Nadu New Entrepreneur-cum-Enterprise Development Scheme (NEEDS)
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Tamil Nadu
subsidy_details: 25% of the project cost as subsidy up to ₹75 Lakh. Additional 3% rebate on loan interest for the entire repayment tenure. Promoter contribution is only 5% for special categories.
required_documents: Detailed Project Report prepared by certified consultant
Land / Building rental deed or patta documents
description: Flagship scheme of Tamil Nadu to nurture first-generation entrepreneurs with 25% capital subsidy up to ₹75 Lakh and 3% interest subvention.

name: Bihar Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana (SC/ST/EBC/Women/Youth)
ministry: Department of Industries, Government of Bihar
subsidy_details: Total project assistance ₹10 Lakh: ₹5 Lakh direct grant (non-repayable) + ₹5 Lakh loan repayable in 84 easy installments (0% interest for Women/SC/ST/EBC, 1% simple interest for Youth).
required_documents: Bihar Permanent Resident Certificate (Niwas Praman Patra)
Current Account statement / cancelled cheque in applicant's enterprise name
description: Bihar government offers ₹10 Lakh package: ₹5 Lakh as direct grant and ₹5 Lakh as interest-free loan to SC, ST, EBC, Women, and Young entrepreneurs.

name: Gujarat Shri Vajpayee Bankable Yojana (VBS)
ministry: Cottage and Rural Industries, Government of Gujarat
subsidy_details: Subsidy rate: 25% for general in rural (20% urban), 40% for SC/ST/Women/Divyangjan in rural (30% urban). Maximum subsidy ₹1,25,000 for industries.
education_requirement: 4th pass or training of min 3 months in relevant field
required_documents: Training certificate or 3-month work experience proof
description: Self-employment credit scheme for cottage and rural artisans of Gujarat with government subsidy up to ₹1.25 Lakh on commercial bank loans.

name: Rajasthan Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyog Protsahan Yojana (MLUPY)
name_hi: राजस्थान मुख्यमंत्री लघु उद्योग प्रोत्साहन योजना (MLUPY)
ministry: Department of Industries and Commerce, Government of Rajasthan
subsidy_details: Loans up to ₹25 Lakh get 8% interest subsidy; ₹25 Lakh to ₹5 Crore get 6%; ₹5 Crore to ₹10 Crore get 5% interest subsidy for 5 years.
description: Attractive interest subvention scheme up to 8% on business and industrial loans up to ₹10 Crore for setting up new enterprises or expanding existing ones.

name: Karnataka Chief Minister Self Employment Generation Programme (CMEGP)
ministry: Department of Commerce and Industries, Government of Karnataka
subsidy_details: General category: 25% (Urban) / 35% (Rural). Special category (SC/ST/Women/Minorities): 35% subsidy up to ₹5 Lakh. Promoter margin only 5% for special categories.
required_documents: EDP Training completion certificate (arranged by DIC)
description: Provides financial subsidy up to 35% on projects up to ₹20 Lakhs to promote rural and urban self-employment among youth in Karnataka.

name: Telangana T-PRIDE (Programme for Rapid Incubation of Dalit Entrepreneurs)
ministry: Industries and Commerce Department, Government of Telangana
subsidy_details: 35% investment subsidy on fixed capital (additional 10% for women entrepreneurs, max ₹75 Lakh). 100% reimbursement of stamp duty, land conversion charges, and power subsidy ₹1.50 per unit for 5 years.
required_documents: SC/ST Caste Certificate issued by MeeSeva
Bank sanction letter and Project Report
description: Special incentive package for SC, ST, and Divyangjan entrepreneurs in Telangana offering up to 45% investment subsidy, stamp duty rebate, and power subsidies.

name: West Bengal Karma Sathi Prakalpa
ministry: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises and Textiles, Government of West Bengal
subsidy_details: Project cost up to ₹2 Lakh funded through cooperative / public sector banks. State provides 15% subsidy (max ₹25,000) and 50% interest subvention for timely repayment.
required_documents: West Bengal Domicile / Voter ID / Aadhaar
description: Facilitates soft loans up to ₹2 Lakh with 15% state subsidy to 3 Lakh unemployed rural and urban youths in West Bengal.

name: Assam Chief Minister's Atmanirbhar Asom Abhijan (CMAAA)
ministry: Skill, Employment and Entrepreneurship Department, Government of Assam
subsidy_details: Professional category (Engineers/Doctors/Agri): ₹5 Lakh (₹2.5L grant + ₹2.5L loan). General category: ₹2 Lakh (₹1L grant + ₹1L loan). 3-day entrepreneurship training provided.
education_requirement: 10th pass for general, Degree for professional stream
description: Financial aid of ₹2 Lakh to ₹5 Lakh (50% grant + 50% interest-free loan) to empower 2 Lakh youth of Assam to establish self-reliant micro enterprises.

name: Odisha Silpi Samruddhi & PMFME State Convergence
name_hi: ओडिशा शिल्पी समृद्धि एवं सूक्ष्म उद्यम योजना
ministry: Handlooms, Textiles & Handicrafts Department, Government of Odisha
subsidy_percentage: 30% to 50% Capital Subsidy for Artisans & Micro Units
subsidy_details: Special financial assistance for certified craftspersons and micro food processing clusters. Subsidized toolkits, margin money subsidy up to 40% for women and SC/ST artisans.
education_requirement: Artisan identity card or basic literacy
description: Comprehensive margin money and technological upgrade subsidy scheme for traditional weavers, handicraftsmen, and rural cottage entrepreneurs of Odisha.
